decisions.rationale: This independently reproduces the accepted R1 attribution gap: source-path existence, an arbitrary behavior string, and assertion-only exclusion files are not causal or falsifiable evidence. The fallback must remain unavailable unless a computed raw-failure/source witness and concrete alternative-cause observations validate.
decisions.smallest_fix: Implement one bounded closed attribution witness whose source digest and raw failure signature are computed from retained bytes and whose reviewed match and category-specific exclusion predicates are validated.

decisions.rationale: This independently reproduces the accepted R1 substitute gap: broad-root, self-reported matching IDs and PASS do not establish an exact C3-HARNESS attempt execution. Attempt confinement plus existing exact launch/controller/worker-result predecessor bindings is a bounded correction with lower risk than granting fabricated substitute credit.
decisions.smallest_fix: Confine assignment, execution, and result to the same attempt-specific C3-HARNESS subtree and verify hash-bound exact controller launch, assignment, worker invocation, and current-tip PASS result identities.
